rationale.consistency: License headers, interface guards, EXPERIMENTAL notes, humanize parsing, nolint:bodyclose, value-receiver ServeHTTP and RegisterHandlerDirective all match sibling handlers and server option code.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles nil/NoBody, ErrNotSupported, hijack, short writes, credit overflow. Per-route handler sets no hard ceiling so it can push past server WriteTimeout; server read ceiling is measured from handler start, slightly later than Go's own deadline.
rationale.scope: Delivers all requested surfaces plus a fitting adapt test. Treats zero idle timeout as disabled (1m only when a rate is set), a defensible but arguable reading of 'default 1 minute'; exports an extra DefaultIdleTimeout constant.
rationale.readability: Clear structure and thorough comments explaining why chunking and header/hijack handling exist. DefaultIdleTimeout name is easily confused with the server's keep-alive IdleTimeout; some comments run long.
rationale.robustness: No panics, loops terminate, unsupported controllers degrade to debug logs, initial write deadline covers 100-continue. Hijack clears deadline even when the server hard timeout was the only one in force on route-level use.
rationale.maintainability: IdleDeadline cleanly separates policy from IO wrappers, but the enable/wrap wiring and idleWindow helper are duplicated between Server and the handler package rather than shared.
